caption_side.source: benchmark/run_benchmark.py --no-clip on data/synthetic run1-3 (29 caption pairs where the cue fired) and benchmark/nanobanana text_overlay (1), 2026-10-17
caption_side.meaning: when exactly one side of a registered pair carries achromatic, high-contrast text-like content in the changed region, that side was the derived copy

web-memes.source: benchmark/run_benchmark.py (phash-only), 563 pairs from 38 meme families, all pairs, margin floor 0.05
web-memes.note: Observed precision of parent-child claims on real web memes, all pairs, including ambiguous ground truth.

web-memes-clean-truth.source: benchmark/run_benchmark.py (phash-only), pairs whose documented original is at least as large as the variant, margin floor 0.05
